organization: Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado (IRN) / Ministério da Justiça
license: Public register (paid access; reuse terms unclear)
notes: Authoritative commercial register. Per-company data (NIPC, firma, sede, CAE, capital, sócios, gerência) is accessed via the PAID certidão permanente (permanent certificate; subscription ~EUR 25/year) or per-document access codes. NO open bulk/API. Keyed on the NIPC (9-digit collective-entity number; = NIF/tax number; VAT = PT + NIPC). The route to identified per-company data, but paid.

license: Public (free to consult); reuse terms unclear
notes: FREE official publication of company acts (constituições, alterações ao pacto/estatutos, dissoluções, etc.) - the free per-company source. Search by NIPC or firma. BUT the search is reCAPTCHA-protected (verified: page references reCAPTCHA + NIPC field) -> automated/bulk access blocked; manual lookups only. References the NIPC. Useful for events/history + free per-company acts (statutes, capital, management changes).

organization: Autoridade Tributária (AT) / INE / Banco de Portugal / IRN
license: Not openly published (filed to AT/INE/Banco de Portugal)
notes: The IES is a single annual filing combining accounting (SNC), tax (AT), statistics (INE) and Banco de Portugal data (balanço + demonstração de resultados). The financial statements are NOT openly published per company. The 'depósito de contas' (deposit of accounts) is part of the commercial register (accessed via paid certidão / the company itself). Structured figures need a commercial provider or the paid register. Banco de Portugal publishes only AGGREGATE sector statistics (Central de Balanços). EUR. Join on NIPC.

organization: Direção-Geral da Política de Justiça (DGPJ) / IRN
notes: Open data (CC-BY-SA). Verified: downloaded RCO (Registo Comercial Online) = 120-row monthly STATISTICAL time series (online registrations by transcription/deposit, accumulated) - NOT a per-company register. Other datasets (empresas, fcpc, insolvencia, eol, enh) are likewise STATISTICAL aggregates (counts of incorporations/extinctions/certificates/insolvencies). No per-company register or financials. Context/statistics only.

source_name: RCBE — Registo Central do Beneficiário Efetivo (beneficial owners)
fields_observed: beneficiários efetivos (name, nationality, DOB month/year, nature/extent of control)
notes: Central register of beneficial owners. General public access restricted after the 2022 CJEU ruling (legitimate interest / obliged entities). Not open bulk. Join on NIPC. Personal data (GDPR). Noted for completeness.

organization: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT) / European Commission
notes: Portuguese VAT/NIF for companies = the 9-digit NIPC; VAT format PT + NIPC. Validate via VIES. The NIPC is the register key; VAT is derivable (PT + NIPC). Validation/enrichment only; does not enumerate companies.

source_name: Commercial aggregators (Racius, Informa D&B / einforma, Iberinform, ...)
fields_observed: company master (NIPC, name, CAE, capital, status)
notes: Vendors (Racius, Informa D&B/einforma, Iberinform) resell the register + parsed IES financials + officers/shareholders + credit. Racius offers FREE basic company search (NIPC, name, CAE, status). The realistic path to STRUCTURED financials + identified bulk at scale (since the register is paid and IES financials are not openly published). Mostly proprietary/paid.
